subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Which browser/search hardening track should remain in this issue versus being split to the existing browser/search issues?
rationale: The issue bundles evaluation, security policy, provider reliability, and benchmark design, and repository policy requires owner/product/security direction before changing browser/CDP or web content boundaries.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the maintainer-owned umbrella for Lightpanda, PinchTab, and comparative matrix decisions while leaving implementation to narrower issues.

options.title: Split And Close Later
options.body: Create or reuse narrower issues for each concrete repro/evaluation track, then close this umbrella after the links capture the remaining work.

options.title: Defer Browser Changes
options.body: Limit this issue to search-provider health and leave Lightpanda/browser-backend work to the existing browser-sandbox feature discussions.

recommendation.title: Keep As Umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the maintainer-owned umbrella for Lightpanda, PinchTab, and comparative matrix decisions while leaving implementation to narrower issues.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent history across both browser/CDP hardening and web-search behavior, while other likely owners cover narrower SearXNG or CDP slices.
